language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hi! My name is Emilie and this is my sister, Joelle, she is an engineer. She works in this winery. It's her job to make sure that everything is stable and sturdy. For that, she uses all kinds of different materials.
Sometimes I go with her. Then I can see all the different materials she works with.
I have seen her work with metal, wood, and glass in the wineries. Sometimes, she works with plastic.
Joelle teaches me a lot about which materials are used to make stuff.
Do you see the t-shirts and berets? They’re great souvenirs and you’ll see them in wineries sometimes! T-shirts and berets are made of a different materials.
Today I'm on another tour with my sister. Will you join us and help me learn about materials?
She sounds like a great sister, Emilie. I hope you learn more about the different materials from Joelle.
